objective.name: known_capacity
objective.description: Defines a capacity reference and the concise description exposed to a pilot as part of its stable known capabilities.

functional._ref_note: Required. Canonical reference to the Brique Capacity.
functional._description_note: Required. Concise description of what the Capacity allows the pilot to do.
functional._target_type_note: Optional. Family of the Capacity, which routes the intentions that aim at it: user (default), matter, reflexive, execution or control. Declared by the architect; agentic_core applies it whatever the model wrote.
